status: C1..C4 independently validated on frozen baseline10; unproved forms remain UNKNOWN
independence: AST receives frozen C# and reference metadata only; IL extractor receives methodDTO only. Neither uses the opposite side to infer structure.

APIs.projection: canonical_plan(ir); canonical_tree(ir). canonical_tree never reads emission_plan.

dispatch.table: ordered section indices; -1 is the proven switch exit

sections.keys: Int32 labels, grouped by shared physical body

switch.raw_sections: node.children are sections; child.data.case_keys preserves semantic labels in source/physical order
switch.source_selector: data.selector and selector_type; selector evaluation/temp-store are preceding source lowering leaves, not target C# statements to transplant independently
switch.tree_limits: Single dense Int32 table, no default body, outside loop/EH frames; cases and all transfer owners must also be complete. Sparse, hybrid, string, constants, nullable and wider governing types remain UNKNOWN where not proved.
switch.string_plan: Dictionary/Hashtable lowering follows pinned Mono, including null/cache guards and source-label map order. No string-switch nodes occur in the mapped baseline source corpus; own fixtures prove plans. Generated fields are never hand-written. Global naming context remains required for metadata reconstruction.

EH.raw_children: try body followed by handler bodies; catch prologue store/pop is a lowering leaf
EH.protected_return: A return node can have opcode leave; source renderer emits C# return within try, never an IL leave statement. Footer reload/ret stays explicit in IR.
EH.implicit_edges: Reflection.Emit adds a try/catch leave even after an explicit protected-return leave. Never drop duplicates or branches to the next instruction.
EH.boundary_labels: MarkLabel and EH boundary metadata are zero-width. A coincident label points at the first actual instruction of the region. The source writer emits EH metadata before labels for that instruction slot; destinations are not rewritten. Fixture evidence separately compares external/internal EH-entry edges.
EH.tree_limits: Flat catch group or single finally with literal epilogues. Nested/combined/filter/fault EH, using/lock equivalence and ambiguous loop ownership are UNKNOWN until separately proved.

logic.AND_if: Recursive literal if(a&&b) versus nested if equivalence; explicit joins retained. Already normalized loops must not be processed twice.

common_loop_test.predicates: ordered leaf/test sequence with every exact branch opcode

logic.limits: Only literal common-target chains are combined. OR conditions with mixed continuations, lifted/overloaded logic and side-effecting constant reductions stay UNKNOWN. Floating .un branches and explicit negation are preserved.

owners.policy: Separate switch and loop frames; continue skips switches. All physical candidate owners must be recorded; never choose the first owner merely because target offsets coincide.
owners.ambiguity: Coincident switch exit/loop continue or break targets, and iterator-suffix versus if-join ownership, remain tree_complete=false. Exact emission-plan coverage does not establish lexical ownership.

application: Bindings must prove source-to-own-IL plan/tree correspondence before original-to-source leaf matching. Synthetic dispatch, catch prologue and protected-return leaves belong to lowering atoms; they are not standalone source statements. Solver complete+wrong rejects; incomplete is distinct from proved wrong and follows the controller's bounded oracle policy.
forbidden: AST bootstrapped from original or own IL
